name: John Mayer Trio · Come When I Call
description: Warm, touch-sensitive electric blues with a clean core and a little bite. An original THR II interpretation of the Trio live sound, not a copy of Mayer's settings.
suggestions: Start with an ES-335-style neck humbucker or another warm neck pickup. Try guitar volume 6–7 for the groove and 9–10 for fills; tone around 6–8. If using a low-output Strat neck pickup, raise Gain slightly. The amp has no Tube Screamer model in this preset, so add a low-gain mid-forward drive pedal for a more singing solo. Set listening level with the THR's physical output control.
